description: Two couples pass through by the right and each couple turns as one.

walkthrough.line: Pass the dancer you face by the right, then courtesy turn with {who}.
walkthrough.teach: Both couples walk forward and pass through by the right, passing right shoulders with the dancer you face. Close up with {who} on the other side and courtesy turn: the robin's left hand in the lark's left, the lark's right hand on the robin's back, the robin walking forward and the lark walking backward until you both face in again.
